page.notes: The words "nudam" and "non" in the last lines are set in a heavier, different typeface than the rest of the page; I have marked them as black letter, but this is uncertain. "præstiterunt" is hard to read at the line end; the mark is doubtful. The long s is printed as f throughout and is transcribed as s (e.g. "verfa" as "versa", "fit" as "sit", "fpectat" as "spectat"). Faint text at the lower right edge is outside the printed page and has been left out.
